_comment: Instance data of helpers/decision-register.cjs (PostToolUse + PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion). register = the ONE versioned file every answer the operator gives through the question tool is appended to (relative to the brain root; commit it like any ledger of a PRIVATE brain repo - never into shared memory or a public repo: questions and answers name people and devices). model = the small model that judges whether a new question asks a matter an earlier answer already decided. min_score = word prefilter threshold (share of rare words). enabled false switches both hooks off. First fill from history: node core/helpers/decision-register.cjs --backfill. recurring_patterns = regexes (case-insensitive) for check-ins asked every session by design in the operator's language (English shapes are built in); a question matching one is never checked and never a match.
